what: Press and hold on empty page space for 1 second (cancelled if moved over 28px or scrolled over 60px) and the rainbow bar at the bottom fills from the left in 1 second, when full, prop icons burst from that spot with matter-js physics — each launched in a random direction at speed 2~4 (physics units) with ±.5 rotation, rising then falling under gravity (1), and the layer turns off once all are more than 300px below the screen. On release the bar disappears in .25s

options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Prop that bursts (size follows the prop box as is, treated as a box with .2 rounded corners)
options.[data-fx-part=progress]: Bar that fills while pressed (if any)

note: On finger screens (hover false) it is not attached — the original also ignores touch. Presses on links, buttons, inputs and drag plates are not counted. The original advances a frame by at most 1000/30ms, but matter-js warns on frames longer than 16.7ms, so the part caps it at 1000/60ms (the same on 60fps screens).
